data.long_meaning: सुर (Sur) means 'God' and ईश (Ish) means 'Lord'. Thus, सुरेश (Sureesh) is the name of the one who is the Lord of the Gods. The name सुरेश carries the meaning “Lord of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose सुरेश usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
